question: Does adaptive image fetching reduce the execution time of equal agent-training work when model inference is excluded?
method: Make inference stages instantaneous and bypass their resource pool, then resimulate the schedule. Do not subtract summed inference service or wait durations from wall time.
interpretation: A counterfactual, inference-excluded completion time for fixed work, not an actual end-to-end training wall-clock speedup.
profile_selection: The former long-model-call profile is omitted because it becomes identical to the short-compute profile once inference service and its queue are removed. All read conditions, fixed controls, and identity cases are retained.
prior_results: The inference-included v1.0.0 release and data/reference/simulation remain unchanged.
